name: foom-functions
description: 품(FOOM) Cloud Functions — 루트 프론트엔드 패키지와 독립된 의존성 트리

scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only auth,functions,firestore,storage --project demo-foom
scripts.test: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,functions,firestore --project demo-foom "vitest run"
